source: Four fresh documented reference processes; timestamped controller requests/responses and actual PNGs only. No executable or ROM state inspected.

minimumBehaviorConsistentWithEvidence.status: Inferred lifecycle rule from two independently repeated collected and uncollected controlled branches.

limits: This establishes only the same 1-1 block after its activation and one before-checkpoint death; level reentry, checkpoint respawn, game-over restart and later-world eligibility are unmeasured.
The uncollected control had already activated the block; it isolates collection from activation, not death before any activation.
Return camera and standing sprite origin match initial conditions exactly; decision native-frame phase differs and is recorded rather than assumed.
No second-death life count was captured after the return probe; absence is established by actual clear cell, jump through it, and no mushroom/1UP text.
These are reference experiments, not recreation campaign wins.
